StudentProgress.title: StudentProgress
StudentProgress.description: Tracks a student's learning progress and quiz results across all stages by seat number.

warmupCompleted.description: List of completed warmup problem indices (0-2).

visualPresetsExplored.description: List of explored visual preset keys (ex1-ex5).

elfBlankSolved.description: Whether the student solved the Stage 1 discovery blank.

sortCompleted.description: Highest number of cards sorted in Stage 2 (0-12).

rankCompletedModes.description: Completed Stage 3 ranking modes (basic, challenge, random).

mazeCompleted.description: Whether the student completed the Stage 4 basketball shooting challenge.

pairDiscussionCount.description: Number of completed Stage 5 pair discussion tasks (0-3).

pairPartnerSeat.description: Seat number of the pair discussion partner (empty or 1-999).

quizSubmitted.description: Whether the student has submitted the Stage 6 quiz.

quizCorrectCount.description: Number of correct answers on the Stage 6 quiz (0-10).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the student record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the student record was last updated.

/studentProgress/{seatId}.description: Stores each student's progress indexed by their seat number.
